# The canonical ranking golden is regenerated by every corpus pin, 2026-11-24

Closes [#680](https://github.com/phynics/cast-iron/issues/680). `crates/search/tests/golden/canonical-top50.txt`
records the top-50 ids of the 50 queries of `tests/e2e/measure-library.mjs`. It used to skip unless the
generated library had the content version that the file named. Nobody refreshed it, so it protected nothing
for three weeks.

- **Repair, not retire.** `synthetic_ranking.rs` pins the ranking rules on a checked-in corpus. The golden
  adds a different signal: how the real library ranks common words after a pin. A pin changes about 460 of the
  2,500 ids, and the changed ids sort by query, so a reviewer can read the diff.
- **The pin PR regenerates it.** `cargo xtask search-golden` (after `cargo xtask content`) rewrites the file.
  The header records the corpus commit and the content version.
- **A stale golden fails, it does not skip.** `the_golden_is_for_the_pinned_corpus` compares the recorded
  commit with `sources/corpus.toml` and needs no generated library, so `Rust checks` fails a pin PR that
  forgot the refresh. `canonical_top50_ranking_matches_the_golden` compares the rankings whenever a generated
  search index exists. A ranking change on purpose (an engine change, a feature alias) regenerates the file in
  the same PR.
- **Format.** A `query: <text>` line starts a block. Every other non-comment line is an id, so `ref/`,
  `book-section/` and later prefixes never read as queries.
